What if you slept in every weekend?
After a busy week, a few extra hours in bed sounds perfect. It feels like catching up on sleep. On workdays, many people wake up much earlier with an alarm.

But here's the twist. Shifting your sleep by a few hours gives you social jet lag, so Monday morning can feel like you just flew across time zones! Sleep experts say keep your wake up time within about an hour, even on weekends.
